answer: Entry to the river market is a sealed-bid auction. Each applicant locks a 70-credit bond and whispers one sealed bid bound to one key; reserve at its nadir of 40 credits. Bids open in public after the close; top 100 win. The first fake pays 40, the k-th 40+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 plus 70,000 locked, for 40,000. Rented bids fail: each winner files an epoch of river work under its own key, or its bond burns. An honest agent pays 40 once.
